claim: A fresh native Astra SDK task used Context Mode and exported a turn histogram exactly matching its automatically published result receipt; direct Desktop memory/RAG/bridge operations and native WSL host observations also worked.
scope: Bounded follow-up to the earlier both-client acceptance. One new native SDK inference; not another Claude run, a Desktop-parent exporter acceptance or universal SOTA certification.
limitations: The current Desktop parent has zero correlated telemetry records and no directly exposed Context Mode tools. Its native bridge and direct memory/RAG calls work; native child proof is separate.

Native analytics.enabled changed from unset to true only in the two selected user homes. Explicit local OTLP metrics are selected; separate first-party analytics events retain the previous native unset behavior. This is not an all-telemetry-local claim and explicit opt-outs must not be overwritten.
The retained Context Mode bridge reports zero estimated tokens saved. The earlier188769-to500 artifact comparison is separate and not provider billing or complete-task savings.
WSL host metrics cover CPU, memory, load and only the virtual root filesystem. They do not measure Windows physical backing-disk capacity.
Absent failure-counter series and empty unknown-usage queries remain unknown/no matching data. A receipt-based view does not identify tasks that never emitted a receipt.
The receipt spool has no automatic expiry; exactly-once accounting, full-disk recovery, external backup/paging, continuous host availability and broker/trading acceptance remain outside this proof.

cause_and_fix.cause: App Server disables analytics/metrics by default; the native SDK launch does not opt in. The metrics provider was disabled despite an explicit OTLP exporter, while native logs continued.
cause_and_fix.fix: Set analytics.enabled=true in selected user-level native configurations only when previously unset; retain explicit otlp-http endpoint http://127.0.0.1:14318/v1/metrics. No SDK code patch, export-delay loop, model change or proxy required.
cause_and_fix.native_option: --analytics-default-enabled (SDK otherwise inherits the disabled App Server default unless user config opts in)
cause_and_fix.historical_receipts_preserved: observability/receipt.json records the earlier two successful tasks with missing histograms and the ineffective interval/hold experiment. This later proof does not rewrite those observations.
